summary: Platinum Analytics Cayman Ltd filed a Form 6-K updating the status of a trading suspension of its Class A Ordinary Shares initiated by the SEC and Nasdaq. The company has been responding to information requests from Nasdaq through late 2025 and early 2026, with a recent response on May 6, 2026. No timeline for resumption of trading is provided. This is a regulatory disclosure of an ongoing halt, not a transactional special situation.
